name: Beast Muisek Vessel
summary: The Beast Muisek Vessel is a vessel used to capture a creature’s muisek. In Feralas, it is used to contain the muisek of bears and runners.

sections.title: A Vessel for Muisek
sections.body: In Feralas, the Beast Muisek Vessel is used on a fallen Ironfur Bear or Longtooth Runner. It shrinks the beast and captures its muisek before the spirit can escape. The captured muisek is then ready for use.

faq.q: What does the Beast Muisek Vessel do?
faq.answer: The Beast Muisek Vessel shrinks a fallen Ironfur Bear or Longtooth Runner and captures its muisek before the spirit can escape.
Muisek is the spirit of a creature, which may escape after a violent death.

faq.q: Which creatures does the vessel work on?
faq.answer: The vessel captures the muisek of fallen Ironfur Bears and Longtooth Runners in Feralas.
